records.arabic_quote: إِنَّ هَذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَنْ شَاءَ اتَّخَذَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ سَبِيلًا (٢٩) وَمَا يَشَاءُونَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَشَاءَ اللَّهُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
records.finding: Full current AR/RU p356 read. Embedded AR has وما يشاؤون (third-person); Q1 has وما تشاؤون (second-person). RU uses «вы» matching Q1, not embedded person. A reading difference remains possible; Q1 alone does not establish corruption.
records.recommended_handling: Flag reading/source and translation basis explicitly; do not overwrite source or assign a qiraa without specialist evidence.

records.finding: Full current AR/RU p567 read. AR cited fragment لا ولا يقبل منها omits Q1 internal تجزي نفس عن نفس شيئا and ends before عدل. RU translates «И не будет принят от неё выкуп»; author immediately explains «أي لا يكون عدل فيقبل», supplying noun conceptually.
records.recommended_handling: Record quote truncation and inferred noun; do not treat contiguous canonical quotation as preserved in AR.
